$description: Fixture only, for check-contrast.mjs against valid/. A mode id misspelt on a pair and another misspelt on an exception. Neither is a value defect and neither used to be reported: an unrecognised mode simply matched no combination, so the pair vanished from the run and the exception stopped applying, and the gate printed a smaller number of checks and the word pass. Do not correct the spellings — they are the test.

pairs.$description: One character wrong. The pairing is real and passes comfortably in every combination; the typo used to remove it from the run entirely.
Sound, and here so the run still has something to check — a file in which nothing at all is evaluated would prove the error was raised without proving the rest of the gate kept working.

exceptions.reason: Fixture only. The waiver itself is sound; its mode id is not. An exception that silently stops applying fails safe rather than open, but it is still a documented decision that has quietly left the building, so the unknown id is an error here too.
